pre_measurement_amendment.reason: Correct documented missing-execution behavior: when no exact execution price exists, retain existing shares instead of silently dropping the position. As-of prices remain mark-only. No rule, threshold, ticker, or acceptance criterion changed.

post_measurement_correction.root_cause: The initial fetch covered only months in which a ticker was a quarterly top500 member. Positions opened before a membership boundary could remain held after that boundary but had no raw prices in the next month, creating artificial permanent missing marks.
post_measurement_correction.correction: Fetch every OOS month for the complete pre-registered 615-symbol union. Signal selection remains PIT top500. Added data is used only to provide raw execution/mark coverage for any possible held ticker.
post_measurement_correction.scope_control: The correction applies the same full-month coverage to the entire pre-registered union, not only to tickers exposed by the invalid result. No strategy rule, threshold, acceptance criterion, or ticker universe union changed.
post_measurement_correction.corrected_run_policy: The corrected replay is an audit correction after OOS was opened, not pristine first-look OOS. Both invalid and corrected results must be reported.

verdict_interpretation.reason: The measured interval is 1.703 years and ends 2026-09-16, so 2026 is YTD. Base return is 5.06% in full-year 2025 and 12.80% in 2026 YTD. The frozen gate still fails, but the sample is too short for a permanent edge-kill conclusion.
verdict_interpretation.forward_policy: Do not tune on touched 2025-2026. Continue the unchanged candidate on genuinely forward data after 2026-09-16 before a terminal keep/kill decision.
